title: Visual impairment (combined acuity and field impairment)
summary: Loss of visual efficiency, or visual impairment, in the better eye. A) Visual efficiency percentage of 20 or less after best correction; or B) Visual impairment value of 1.00 or greater after best correction.

children.criterion: A visual efficiency percentage of 20 or less after best correction (see 2.00A7d). Calculated as: visual acuity efficiency percentage (2.00A7b) × visual field efficiency percentage (2.00A7c) ÷ 100, in the better eye.
A visual impairment value of 1.00 or greater after best correction (see 2.00A8d). Calculated as: visual acuity impairment value (2.00A8b) + visual field impairment value (2.00A8c), in the better eye.
